purpose: Define bounded deterministic recursion and cycle handling for canonical trees, Topic inheritance/composition, references, relations and flows without banning valid recursive semantic structures.

owns: Core Recursion and Graph Safety semantics

topics.name: Recursion
topics.purpose: Define bounded deterministic recursion and cycle handling for canonical trees, Topic inheritance/composition, references, relations and flows without banning valid recursive semantic structures.

semantics.recursion_rule: Recursion is allowed where the owning semantic model permits it.
semantics.visited_rule: Readers maintain visited identity/edge/ref context to prevent infinite traversal.
semantics.cycle_rule: Cycles are semantic facts to validate, not traversal bugs to silently remove.
semantics.acyclic_rule: Acyclicity applies only where explicitly required by the owning semantic dimension.
semantics.bound_rule: Traversal is bounded by resource rules but bound failures remain visible and cannot be reported as complete results.
semantics.projection_rule: A projection may choose a finite view depth, but truncation is projection metadata, not canonical absence.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant semantics are explicit and deterministic.

hard_gates.condition: valid recursive structure rejected solely because it is recursive
reader loops indefinitely because visited tracking is absent
bounded/truncated graph reported as complete canonical graph
projection depth truncation interpreted as semantic absence

references.purpose: Reference traversal records and validates cycles.
Topic inheritance/composition recursion has explicit cycle rules.

prose.summary: Define bounded deterministic recursion and cycle handling for canonical trees, Topic inheritance/composition, references, relations and flows without banning valid recursive semantic structures.
